connector.name: Gilbert MCP
connector.registryDescription: Gilbert meetings: list, search, and fetch transcripts & summaries via MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gilbert-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hugof1234 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GILBERT_API_KEY
env.description: Your Gilbert API key (format: glbrt_live_...). Get one from your Gilbert admin dashboard with at least the meetings:read scope.

env.name: GILBERT_BASE_URL
env.description: Gilbert API base URL. Defaults to the official hosted API; override only for self-hosted deployments.
